run_get_hidden_states: run get_hidden_states to extract hidden states from a transformer model for given prompt inputs
run_generate_with_patching_layer: run generate_with_patching_layer to generate text completions by patching hidden states at a specific transformer layer
run_get_completions_from_patching: run get_completions_from_patching to generate completions by patching hidden states across source and target layers
test_get_hidden_states: test get_hidden_states by passing a model and prompt inputs and verifying returned hidden state tensor shape
test_generate_with_patching_layer: test generate_with_patching_layer by patching a hidden state at a target layer position and verifying generated completions
